# Vendored icon sets

Copied for the thumbnail generator (`research/mockups/tools/thumbnail.py`), offline, unmodified. A curated
subset; fetch more from the same package version into the same folder when a subject needs one.

| Folder | Set | Version and source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pixelarticons/` | Pixelarticons, 24 px pixel grid | pixelarticons@2.4.1, `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixelarticons@2.4.1/svg/<name>.svg` | MIT (`pixelarticons/LICENSE`) |
| `phosphor/regular/`, `phosphor/fill/` | Phosphor, regular and fill weights (same names; fill files renamed without the `-fill` suffix) | @phosphor-icons/core@2.1.1, `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@phosphor-icons/core@2.1.1/assets/<weight>/<name>[-fill].svg` | MIT (`phosphor/LICENSE`) |

MIT requires keeping the licence text with copies of the files; no credit is needed in the images.
